parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/StreamErrorAnalyticsTests.swift`. Although the Jaccard similarity of 0.75 indicates structural near-duplication, the two methods — `streamErrorIncludesSessionDuration` (line 98) and `streamErrorAfterStallIncludesStallDuration` (line 124) — are distinct test scenarios: one verifies that a session duration is included in a stream-error analytics event, and the other verifies that a stall duration is included after a stall event. Merging or abstracting them would obscure the intent of each individual test case and couple unrelated behavioral assertions. Per the restraint rules, any cluster where all participating records are test fixtures warrants no-action.
